text:
alex: Heads-up: priming the new eu-4 GPU cluster tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan: warm GPU pools, short soak at 1.5x expected traffic, then tune autoscaler throttle + cooldowns. No customer-facing changes — ops, please validate the checklist.
mira: Can you paste the checklist? Need to confirm ENI/NIC limits and logging levels.
alex: Checklist (high level):
- pre-provision GPU nodes (pool: rtx-80-8x) and label nodes `region=eu4,pool=rtx-80`
- set infra min_replicas=6 for renderer service
- warm cache by replaying 10k synthetic requests (prefix caching enabled)
- run 30m soak at 1.5x QPS, then 90m at 0.8x if green
- autoscaler start params: target_util=0.6, scale_up_step=3, cooldown=60s, throttle_window=120s
- fallback route to eu-west2 for overflow
- cost watch: enable burn-rate alert (>=2x baseline)
ben: Added runbook command: `./infra/provision --region eu4 --pool rtx-80 --count 12`
ben: Soak runner: `./test/soak_runner --region eu4 --multiplier 1.5 --duration 00:30`
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: eu4-priming (provision+soak) — start at 2026-05-12T22:00:00Z by alex
sre-oncall: Note: network NIC limit per AZ is lower in eu-4. If node readiness flaps, throttle new pod creation and don't auto-scale past 80% of advertised pool until net metrics stabilize.
mira: What are the target success metrics for the soak?
alex: Success criteria:
- generation p50 < 180ms, p95 < 650ms
- queue length < 6 for >90% samples
- avg batch size >= 16 (cost target)
- GPU util between 55-85% (no long tail at 100%)
- errors < 0.2% (5xx/timeouts)
- cold-starts < 3 per 1000 requests
ben: If p95 spikes during warm-up, relax scale_up_step or increase cooldown. Recommendation: if p95 > 700ms for 5m, bump scale_up_step +1 and extend cooldown to 120s.
alex: We'll run a quick A/B canary: canary pool (2 nodes) with aggressive vs baseline policies; canary gets 5% traffic.
mira: I'll attach the canary dashboard during run and enable opaque-fallback to eu-west2 for queued requests >20s.
ben: Command to prime cache: `python tools/replay_requests.py --prefix /v1/generate --count 10000 --parallel 20`
alex: Starting warm replay 21:40 UTC to prefill KV cache — should reduce initial p95.
ops-bot: `eu4-provision` job: nodes=12 status=OK ip-allocation=12/12
sre-oncall: Watch for node-level I/O saturation. Previously in apac3 we hit nvme contention due to local debug logging; disable debug-level logs for soak.
mira: Setting cluster logging to INFO now.
ben: Starting soak runner in 5m; will stream minimal logs here.
ben: [logs] soak-runner: warmup completed; qps=1200; target=1.5x
ben: [metric-snapshot] p50=120ms p95=430ms gpu_util=62% avg_batch=17 queue_len=3 error_rate=0.12%
alex: Nice. Keep watch for autoscaler flapping around 22:18.
ben: At 22:18 observed scale_up events x2 within 4m, autoscaler throttled. Manual adjust: set throttle_window=180s and scale_up_step=2.
mira: After throttle change stability improved; p95 down to 390ms.
alex: Cost note: burst nodes increased hourly burn ~1.8x for priming — expected. We'll autoshrink to baseline in 2h if green.
jordan: I'll take handoff at 23:15 UTC to monitor alerts and trigger rollback if error_rate > 0.5% for >10m.
alex: Thanks. After 90m soak and green checks we'll mark eu-4 ready for limited traffic. Updating runbook with tweaks: throttle_window=180s, scale_up_step=2, logging INFO, prime-replay=10k.
mira: Adding postmortem pointers: ENI limit, logging level, prime-replay duration, and autoscaler defaults.
ops-bot: eu4-priming job finished: soak=30m status=GREEN post-checks=PASS handoff=jordan
